_meta.source: Teks asli heartodex (descriptionOriginal di file data) dengan salah ketik yang jelas dibetulkan. descriptionOriginal tetap apa adanya.

animal-keeper: Discover the favorite foods for 8 animal groups.
rocket-sponsor: Earn a total of 500,000 Gold by selling items to Gold Merchant Albert Jr.
animal-neighbor: Reach Bond Level 10 with 8 animal groups.
shoals-blessing: Trigger 100 Shoals in total during Fishing Events.
fishing-machine: Catch a total of 50 fish over 100kg each.
sea-fishing-master: Obtain all titles in Daily Sea Fishing Events.
shoal-caller: Trigger 3 Shoals in a single Fishing Event.
shark-frenzy: Catch 3 sharks from gold-glowing fish shadows during a single Sea Fishing event.
mystic-fisher: Trigger the hidden phase of Fishing Event 10 times in total.
starlight-fisher: Catch 4 5-Star fish in a single Fishing Event.
strong-sailor: Catch fish over 100kg for 2 consecutive times.
rainbow-luck: Trigger 2 Rainbow Hybrid Blessings in a single multi-area watering.
plentiful-harvest: Harvest a 5-star crop during Bountiful Harvest.
human-insect-attractor: Trigger 4 Swarms in a single Insect Catching event.
five-insects-blessing: Catch 5 5-Star insects during a single Insect Catching Event.
swarm-commander: Trigger 100 Swarms in total during Insect Catching Events.
insect-harvester: Catch 3 insects with a single insect-catching bubble.
exploration: Trigger the hidden phase in Insect Catching Event 10 times in total.
insect-catching-party: Share Inflatable Insect Attractor with 100 D.G. Members in total.
onsen-mountain-insect-king: Obtain all titles in Bait the Insects Events.
joyful-chorus: Trigger 3 Bird Waves in a single Birdwatching Event.
bush-wholesaler: Share Camouflage Bush with 100 D.G. Members in total.
decisive-moment: Obtain 10 5-Star Info Cards in a single Birdwatching Event.
harmony-with-breeze: Trigger 100 Bird Waves in total during Birdwatching Events.
cloud-walker: Trigger the hidden phase of Birdwatching Event 10 times in total.
party-animal: Party Player Dream reaches Party Animal
licensed-ready: Participate in ocean cleanup events and remove large pollutants 60 times total
ocean-cleanup-expert: Reach Level 10 in Ocean Cleaning Hobby
cleanup-master: Obtain all titles from Ocean Cleanup Events.
idea-hamster: Party Artisan Dream reaches Idea Hamster
tides-of-life: Reach the "Tidal Abundance" eco-fish level at any underwater seamount.
no-corner-left-behind: Trigger the hidden phase of Ocean Cleanup Event 10 times in total
bestselling-author: Reach a cumulative total of 1000 unique purchases for the books you created
golden-music-cd: Music Dream reaches Golden Music CD.
ice-elf: Figure Skating Dream reaches Ice Elf.
hidden-achievement-1: Sell a total of 10 books; each book must be purchased by 200 DIFFERENT players.
romantic-skater: Skate hand-in-hand with a friend under a meteor shower.
beneath-the-meteor-shower: Make a wish under the meteor with friends.
logistics-beaver: Accumulate 5,000 Fresh Sprouts for a team during the Build Challenge.
foreman-beaver: Participated in 4 Build Challenges with works successfully entering the Exhibition Phase
beyond-the-clouds: Obtain all titles from Hot Air Balloon Events.
merge-into-one: In a Hide & Seek party, stayed possessed as a Mysterious Grimkin for 4 minutes without being found by the Investigative Journalist
repair-expert: Share Repair Kit with 100 D.G. Members in total.
bold-grimkin: In a Hide & Seek Party, while possessing a Mysterious Grimkin, pop 20 Psionic Bubbles
sharpshooter-basics: In a Hide & Seek Party, as an Investigative Journalist, successfully captured Special Photos 2 times in a row
quick-draw-starter: As a Investigative Journalist in a Hide & Seek Party, discovered 3 Mysterious Grimkins within 60 seconds
wind-chaser: Discover all the easter eggs in the Hot Air Balloon Event.
rainbow-messenger: Share Rainbow Bouquet with 50 D.G. Members in total.
